title: Service Requests, Call Fees and Fee Refunds on Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
**Rule S1.** Service requests on a Rental Property Service Contracts contract are accepted only while the contract status is active, as the contract's system record shows.

**Rule S2.** A request names one unit and one failed item. The landlord may always place requests.

**Rule S3.** An authorized tenant may place a request only when the tier allows tenant requests and the caller's name and phone match the authorized tenant contact name and phone on the contract. The name and phone are what the caller states; the contract record is what they must match.

**Rule S4 — fees.** All fees are billed to the landlord, never to the tenant.
- A new-failure request is charged the tier's service call fee once.
- A recall for the same unit and item placed no later than the tier's repair guarantee in calendar days after the earlier repair was completed carries no fee; a later return visit is a new failure.
- A second opinion may be requested only by the landlord after an initial determination and is charged the service call fee times the tier's second-opinion fee rate, rounded to the cent, with nothing posted when that is zero.
- A routine request for an after-hours visit is also charged the tier's after-hours surcharge; emergencies never are.

**Rule S5 — emergencies.** A request is an emergency when the failure leaves a unit without heat in freezing weather, without running water, without electrical power, or with an active leak that cannot be stopped at a fixture shutoff.

**Rule S6.** The fee of each fee type (standard visit, second opinion, after-hours surcharge) is charged at most once per service request.

**Rule S7 — refunds.** Fees are refunded in full only when the request is cancelled before any contractor is assigned, or when a fee was charged in error; a not-covered determination never refunds the fee.

## Questions the rules answer (hypothetical requests)

**A routine request for an after-hours visit, new failure, on Bridgewell Rental Combo: what is billed?** The $125.00 service call fee and the $75.00 after-hours surcharge, two charges to the landlord.

**The same failure reported as an emergency after hours?** The $125.00 service call fee only; an emergency never carries the surcharge.

**A second opinion on Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus?** $100.00 times 0.00 is zero, so nothing is posted.

**A second opinion on Bridgewell Rental Systems?** $125.00 times 1.00, so $125.00.

**A recall for the same unit and item on Bridgewell Rental Systems, placed on the 30th calendar day after the earlier repair was completed?** No fee. Placed on the 31st day, it is a new failure and carries the service call fee.

**A caller gives the tenant name on file but a different phone number?** The name and phone must both match the contract; the caller may not place the request as the authorized tenant.

**The request is found not covered: is the fee refunded?** No.
